atDirectives.name: @theme
@source
atDirectives.description: Explicitly register source files Tailwind should scan for class names, for cases automatic detection misses.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Register a custom utility that works with Tailwind's variants such as `hover:` and `lg:`. Replaces the v3 `@layer utilities` pattern.

atDirectives.name: @variant
@config
atDirectives.description: Load a legacy JavaScript-based configuration file.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Use the `@apply` directive to inline any existing utility classes into your own custom CSS. This is useful when you find a common utility pattern in your HTML that you’d like to extract to a new component.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: If you want to use `@apply` or `@variant` in the <style> block of a Vue or Svelte component, or within CSS modules, you will need to import your theme variables, custom utilities, and custom variants to make those values available in that context with `@reference`.
